correctness.rationale: For every arm permutation, fixed configurations split into genuine clopen strata indexed by orbit counts on non-fixed arm cycles. The radial factors are contractible and the remaining factor is a configuration space on the fixed-arm star. The established one-essential-vertex Morse theorem eliminates homology above degree one and supplies the exact Euler generating series. A finite-order simplicial Lefschetz argument converts the fixed-set Euler series to the claimed full rational character. Two exact cycle-index identities yield the closed partition formula and, by bounded partition enumeration, the universal first invariant at five particles. Independent signed cubical enumeration checked 66 arm permutations across five graph-particle cases and matched each character coefficient; those finite checks are not used to infer the uniform theorem.

originality.rationale: The new statement simultaneously handles all arm counts and all unordered particle counts, with a sharp five-particle onset for invariant first homology. Farley–Sabalka determines nonequivariant ranks but not traces; Ramos–Yun treats the two-particle star representation; earlier three-particle results are subsumed and not claimed new. The broader representation-stability and presentation literature inspected does not state the complete two-variable cycle-index character. No indexed covering result was identified; unindexed coverage and unrecognized implications of general equivariant formulae remain genuine residual risks.
residual_risks: An unindexed paper or a relevant inaccessible treatment may state an equivalent all-particle character without easily recognized terminology.

value.rationale: The full two-parameter character is a complete and reusable invariant of every arm-permutation action on first rational homology of every unordered star configuration, strengthening only-known nonequivariant ranks and low-particle characters. The first invariant degree at exactly five particles, independent of the number of arms, is a natural sharp threshold for symmetric particle motions, not an arbitrary chosen census or a routine single additional particle count. The formula permits exact extraction of all cycle-class traces and invariant dimensions at arbitrary n,m.
